question:
Which letter replaces the question mark in the given diagram?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7772bd0109c5d883f10fdaed3f258d7314020c021ab2eba81958e3dd5d05657e.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**The logic followed here is: **The sum of the position values of each row is 10.

1st row: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e4791a3a268ec745eaee888b319288da3bc344406aeac313d7e8dda224c1127.png] → J(10) = 10

2nd row: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd53bf9c5cc9cb988c42c58bbfb227c82f5035e8c3f26bd7d6c730dceed7a64d.png] → D(4) + F(6) = 10

3rd row: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7804add2abbff0ba9695bc40b11516aa34f275ed81d21714ca5f45fcea8b578e.png] → G(7) + A(1) + B(2) = 10

Similarly,

4th row: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d018d65f350d2cf3003eb1fecff4b1aae9860c89cc1623683b4f2e50bc2d181c.png] → D(4) + A(1) + ? + B(2) = 10

→ ? = 10 - (4 + 1 + 2)

→ ? = 10 - 7

→ ? = 3 

So, the letter of position value '3' is 'C'

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
